sections.h2: Gas gensets cost about half as much to fuel as diesel gensets

chart.title: Gas genset fuel costs ₹6.06 per kVA-hour, against ₹12.6 for diesel
chart.sub: Operating fuel cost, rupees per kVA-hour.
chart.source: Centre for Science and Environment feasibility comparison.

sections.means: A gas genset's fuel cost is about half a diesel genset's, though its upfront cost runs about 50 per cent higher.
sections.todo: Sites with frequent or long outages inside PNG-served areas should price a gas genset against diesel on running cost.
